mechanism_narrative: The sharp week-over-week rebound in WORKPLACES from -48.6 to -18.9 in t-0w signals commuters returning to offices, which raises weekday footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -48.6 at t-1w to -18.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below its last 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES remaining above -25.

mechanism_narrative: Transit recovery past -40 is a policy-easing signal: once TRANSIT exceeds -40, mobility restrictions have loosened enough for retail footfall to rise over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -46.1 to -38.9 in t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains above -40 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility falling from 15.9 to 10.0 while TRANSIT improves from -46.1 to -38.9 indicates people are leaving home for non-essential activities; the joint signal predicts higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 15.9 to 10.0 while TRANSIT rose from -46.1 to -38.9 in t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays below 12 and TRANSIT above -40 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Post-holiday winter lull: PARKS remains negative and GROCERY_PHARM is elevated, indicating discretionary trips are being deferred; RETAIL_REC will fall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -13.0 and GROCERY_PHARM at +11.3 in t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last 28-day mean while PARKS stays below -5 and GROCERY_PHARM stays above +10.

mechanism_narrative: In an Omicron-wave suppression regime, deeply negative TRANSIT and WORKPLACES cap retail recovery: as long as TRANSIT < -30 and WORKPLACES < -15, RETAIL_REC remains below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last 28-day mean even though TRANSIT stays below -30 and WORKPLACES below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in PARKS below -10 signals cold weather driving trips indoors; this substitution lifts indoor retail traffic, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -5.1 to -13.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -10 for the next week but RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is lower than its last 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: As vaccine-pass enforcement stabilizes, GROCERY_PHARM positive growth from +3.7 to +11.3 shows essential retail is resilient and pulls non-essential RETAIL_REC upward over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from +3.7 to +11.3 over t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES from troughs is necessary for a retail rebound; if both continue improving, RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks, but if either stalls, it falls.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved while RESIDENTIAL fell in t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean.
